title: A Kernel Framework for Linear Operator Equations
abstract: arXiv:2611.31626v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Solving linear operator equations with nonlocal terms or heterogeneous constraints often requires specific numerical schemes. We develop a unified approach based on embedding such equations into a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS). Differential, boundary, and integral operators are represented by their Riesz representers in the RKHS. The equations are solved in the regularized least-squares sense at finitely many collocation points. The solution is a finite linear combination of operator-induced representers and is obtained from a single linear system. Its sensitivities, such as financial Greeks, follow by direct differentiation. To reduce the computational cost for large collocation sets, we introduce a Nystr\"om approximation based on subsampling the operator-induced representers. translated_title: 线性算子方程的核框架
translated_abstract: 求解具有非局部项或异质约束的线性算子方程通常需要特定的数值格式。我们开发了一种基于将此类方程嵌入再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）的统一方法。微分算子、边界算子和积分算子在RKHS中由其Riesz表示元表示。方程在有限多个配置点上以正则化最小二乘意义求解。所得解是算子诱导表示元的有限线性组合，并通过求解单个线性系统获得。其敏感性（如金融中的希腊字母）可通过直接微分得到。为降低大规模配置点集的计算成本，我们引入了一种基于对算子诱导表示元进行子采样的Nyström近似。在正则化经验范数意义下，该方法在缩减的试探空间内给出该解的最佳逼近。数值算例涵盖常（微分方程等）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一的再生核希尔伯特空间框架，将带非局部项或异质约束的线性算子方程的求解归结为单个线性系统，并借助Nyström近似降低大规模配置点问题的计算成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified RKHS framework that solves linear operator equations with nonlocal terms or heterogeneous constraints via a single linear system, and introduces a Nyström approximation to reduce computational cost for large collocation sets.
